BH-7630, comment 6315926752 (operator, 2026-10-21: rc=4 repeats within 24h raise one alert per project, not one per PR). After one setup-blocked rate alert for a project (br_setup_rate), the next one for that project waits this long, and no per-park setup page (br_setup_blocked) is sent for that project in the meantime; the record, event and log line stay per park. The epoch is in state/blocked-resolver/

/setup-blocked.alerted. A non-number or a value under 3600 falls back to 86400.
